town.text: Shards, word, a boat at midnight. All for sale. Which do you need?
town.direction: dry, low, unhurried; every sentence an offer

town.text: Prices went up. Everything's colder, and cold costs.
You didn't see me. That one's free.
Mind the docks after dark. Not everyone down here is as friendly as me.
Funny thing. I'm selling more shards than the Vale ought to have. Don't spread that about.
town.direction: lower, the only time it doesn't sound like an offer

town.text: Everybody wants the same thing in the end. I just get there first.

battle_start.text: Last offer. Walk away and I forget your faces.

low_hp.text: All right. All right. Let's talk terms.

defeat.text: Fine. Put it on my tab.
